notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.content: [p]Adjustments and fixes made to improve the game experience, especially in story mode.[/p][p][/p][p]- Screen Reader additions (in Tutorial, Tournament, Settings and popups);[/p][p]- Gameplay bug fixes and adjustments (AI freezing, difficulty, AI variation);[/p][p]- Settings screen adjustments (Button Remapping);[/p][p]- UI navigation and control adjustments;[/p][p]- UI and character animation adjustments;[/p][p]- Game Localization adjustments and additions;[/p][p]- Sound adjustments (default volume, video mixing and some game sounds);[/p][p]- Subtitles and fixes in the video player;[/p][p]- Fixes for game crashes and freezes;[/p][p]- Steam Achievements fixes;[/p]
